mechanism_narrative: A steady reduction in the TRANSIT deficit over three consecutive weeks signals a broad mobility recovery that lifts retail and recreation footfall, producing higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -25.7 to -20.9 over t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days when TRANSIT improves for three consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean crosses above 0 percent, it indicates a return of routine errands and local shopping, which spills over into retail and recreation, raising RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the two weeks following a GROCERY_PHARM crossing above 0 percent.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in WORKPLACES combined with elevated RESIDENTIAL indicates a shift to staying home, which reduces footfall in retail and recreation zones, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next week.

evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES dropped to -12.7 and RESIDENTIAL is 11.7 in t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next week despite WORKPLACES dropping >5 points and RESIDENTIAL >10 percent.
